Stackpole]]'s novella "[[Side Trip]]," which was published in the [[February]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 12|twelfth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal12" />
